title: File upload dropzone with previews
when: The user wants an area where people drop or pick files, see them listed with previews and remove them before sending.
prompt:
Goal: A dropzone built on a real file input, with type and size checks, previews, removal and announced changes.
Steps:
1. <input type="file" id="files" multiple accept="image/*,.pdf"> visually hidden but focusable, and a <label for="files"> styled as the drop area.
2. On dragover call preventDefault and add a highlight class; on drop read event.dataTransfer.files.
3. Check each file type and size (for example 5 MB) and list rejections with the reason.
4. List accepted files with name, size in KB or MB and a Remove button (type="button", aria-label="Remove photo.jpg").
5. Image previews use URL.createObjectURL; call revokeObjectURL on removal.
6. Announce changes in role="status": 3 files added.
Quality bar:
- Keyboard users get the same result through the input.
- The drop area shows a clear hover state.
- File names are inserted with textContent.
Pitfalls:
- Hiding the input with display: none, which removes it from the keyboard.
- Trusting the extension only.
- Leaking object URLs.
Verify:
- [ ] The file input has a label.
- [ ] Drop and pick both add files.
- [ ] Oversize files are rejected with a message.
- [ ] Remove buttons have names.
Output: Dropzone markup in the form, dropzone.css and dropzone.js.

examples.input: area para arrastar fotos e PDFs com previa
examples.output: label as drop area over a hidden file input, 5 MB limit, thumbnails with Remove, status 2 files added
